title: About two results for new valid juggling sequences
summary: In this note, we study two simple operations for extending juggling (siteswap) sequences, called first throws and last catches. Both constructions come from a natural question for a juggler: how can one add throws at the beginning or catches at the end of a pattern without creating a collision? Using landing times and the permutation test, we give necessary and sufficient conditions under which these constructions, when applied to an arbitrary valid siteswap, produce another valid siteswap.
